Annotation Interface EventListener

@Retention(RUNTIME) @Target(METHOD) public @interface EventListener
Used to state an event handler

  • Element Details

    • priority

      @Range(from=-2147483648L,to=2147483647L) int priority
      What priority your handler has compared to other handlers. Lower the priority for first runs. All Cyrus Anti-Cheat listeners use Not-Specified while all other Cyrus event handlers use IEventManager.VANILLA_ACTION_PRIORITY. By default this is set at 100
      Returns:
      The priority of the event handler
      Default:
      100

    • ignoreCancellation

      boolean ignoreCancellation
      If the event is cancelled before your handler is used. Stating this as true will mean your event handler will still run. This is false by default.

      Note: any level changes will not take effect

      Returns:
      If the event handler should ignore being cancelled
      Default:
      false

    • ignoreCheck

      boolean ignoreCheck
      Disable this if you want to know why your event isn't firing as it prevents the checks to ignore your event handler, as a result an error will likely occur for why it is not firing.
      Returns:
      if the event should ignore its safety checks
      Default:
      false

    • waitFor

      boolean waitFor
      States if the event trigger should wait for your event handler to finish. If you are not making any level changes it is better to set this to 'false'
      Returns:
      If the event handler should be waited for it to finish
      Default:
      true
